## Summary / 变更说明

- What does this PR change and why? / 本次修改了什么、解决什么问题？

## Type of Change / 变更类型

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Refactor / docs / CI (`refactor:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [ ] `xcodebuild test -scheme Sonote-Package -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' -configuration Release` passes with 0 failures
- [ ] Tested in both Light & Dark appearance (if UI changed)
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, or personal meeting data committed
- [ ] Updated `README.md` / `README_EN.md` or `CHANGELOG.md` if user-facing behavior changed
